semiconductor_relevance: High — RPS Co., Ltd. specializes in air bearing spindles and related equipment crucial for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: RPS Co., Ltd. is a leading manufacturer of air bearing spindles and ceramic vacuum chuck tables, essential for precision machining in semiconductor production. Established in 2005, the company has localized production capabilities, enhancing national competitiveness in the semiconductor equipment sector.
